tour.label: Guided tour
tour.boardBody: Drag pieces to move; everyone in the room sees the same position live. Edit mode also allows hypothetical positions that do not follow the rules.
tour.analysesBody: Every game or setup you open lives here with its own revision. Import games or start a fresh analysis from this list.
tour.movesBody: The mainline runs flat and variations are indented blocks. Comments and NAGs belong to the occurrence they annotate; the active one is boxed.
tour.engineBody: No engine is connected yet, and the panel says so. When one is, its evaluation, lines and thinking time appear here and the bar next to the board fills.
tour.importBody: Paste a PGN or open a game from your library; importing replays it into this room through the normal move validation.
tour.searchBody: Search canonical games by player, colour, result, opening, date and position. Results open as an analysis in the room you are in.
tour.helpBody: This tour and the keyboard shortcuts live in the shell header, on every screen.
